about.en: SpaceX bStock (SPCXB) is a tokenized share of Space Exploration Technologies Corp. issued by BTECH Holdings Ltd, a special purpose vehicle registered in the Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM), under Binance's bStocks brand. It is a BEP-20 token on BNB Chain at 0xbe9d156892e55e7154bcd3cb0fea677f9d3103e1, backed 1:1 by the underlying shares held in segregated custody. Holders have a claim on the issuer, not registered ownership of SpaceX stock.
